name: The majority voted against an [Australian Greens amendment](https://www.openaustralia.org.au/senate/?gid=2026-04-01.13.4) that would have removed the upper limit for urgent payment requests, meaning it did not succeed. ### Amendment text > *(1) Schedule 2, item 9, page 12 (lines 15 and 16), omit "an amount between $20 and $200", substitute "an amount that is equal to or greater than $20".*
